product_one_liner.value: SiteVue AI combines fixed and wearable cameras with real-time AI video analytics to help manufacturers and industrial operations teams identify bottlenecks, improve productivity and quality, and monitor worker safety.

pricing_page.notes: SiteVue AI, Inc. publishes Free and Corporations pricing for its OrgVault service. The manufacturing-camera website has no public pricing page; its FAQs describe per-camera subscription billing.

employee_band.notes: The company reported 37 employees in August 2026; its company profile reports 40.

hq_location.notes: The corporate office is in Franklin, Tennessee; the company press release describes the broader location as Nashville.

eng_blog.notes: No company blog or engineering-blog index was located; LinkedIn marketing posts are not an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation and API references exist for OrgVault, whose operator page explicitly identifies SiteVue AI, Inc. as its provider; no comparable public documentation was located for the manufacturing-camera product.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No public careers page, current job board, or live AI/ML requisition was located; existing employee profiles do not establish an opening.

model_provider.value: SiteVue AI — in-house, custom-trained computer-vision models
model_provider.notes: The company and its investor say SiteVue trains its own models; no particular model architecture or third-party model provider is named.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page for OrgVault, explicitly provided by SiteVue AI, Inc., disclaims SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA certification and claims none of the five requested certifications.

last_funding.notes: Latest public announcement: August 6, 2026. Earlier May 2026 coverage reported a $7 million seed close; the August announcement reports $7.5 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 6, 2026 seed announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No public careers page, current job board, or live qualifying sales posting was located.

launched_6mo.notes: Readable company posts and the August funding release describe the product but do not establish a qualifying new product or major-feature launch date; a third-party launch listing labels the funding announcement a launch, which the primary announcement does not confirm.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete, dated executive roster or verified C-level/VP joining or departure announcement was found. A directory lists a VP of Operations but does not establish a start date.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Integration signal only: SiteVue-operated OrgVault names an Attio connector. The subprocessor page explicitly says these are customer-selected integrations; this does not establish internal CRM adoption by SiteVue.
